```python
import random
import tkinter as tk
from datetime import date
from tkinter import messagebox

from puzzles import PUZZLES

COLORS = ["#f9df6d", "#a0c35a", "#b0c4ef", "#ba81c5"]
MAX_MISTAKES = 4
BG = "#efefe6"
INK = "#121212"


def todays_puzzle():
    return PUZZLES[date.today().toordinal() % len(PUZZLES)]


class Game(tk.Tk):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.title("Daily Word Connections")
        self.configure(bg=BG)
        self.resizable(False, False)
        self.solution = todays_puzzle()
        self.group_map = {frozenset(ws): (cat, lvl) for cat, lvl, ws in self.solution}
        self.words = [w for _, _, ws in self.solution for w in ws]
        random.shuffle(self.words)
        self.selected = []
        self.mistakes = MAX_MISTAKES
        self.locked = False
        self.solved_frame = tk.Frame(self, bg=BG)
        self.solved_frame.pack(fill="x", padx=12, pady=(12, 0))
        tk.Label(self, text="Create four groups of four!", bg=BG, fg=INK,
                 font=("Helvetica", 13, "bold")).pack(pady=(10, 2))
        self.msg = tk.Label(self, text="", bg=BG, fg=INK, font=("Helvetica", 11))
        self.msg.pack()
        self.dots = tk.Label(self, text="", bg=BG, fg=INK, font=("Helvetica", 12))
        self.dots.pack(pady=(2, 6))
        self.grid_frame = tk.Frame(self, bg=BG)
        self.grid_frame.pack(padx=12)
        self.cells = {}
        btns = tk.Frame(self, bg=BG)
        btns.pack(pady=10)
        for text, cmd in (("Shuffle", self.shuffle), ("Deselect", self.deselect), ("Submit", self.submit)):
            tk.Button(btns, text=text, command=cmd, bg="#8f8f8f", fg="white",
                      font=("Helvetica", 11, "bold"), relief="flat", width=9,
                      padx=6, pady=4).pack(side="left", padx=4)
        self.render()
        self.update_dots()

    def render(self):
        for w in self.grid_frame.winfo_children():
            w.destroy()
        self.cells = {}
        for i, word in enumerate(self.words):
            b = tk.Button(self.grid_frame, text=word.upper(), relief="flat",
                          bg="white" if word not in self.selected else "#5a594e",
                          fg=INK if word not in self.selected else "white",
                          font=("Helvetica", 11, "bold"), width=10, pady=10,
                          command=lambda wd=word: self.toggle(wd))
            b.grid(row=i // 4, column=i % 4, padx=3, pady=3)
            self.cells[word] = b

    def update_dots(self):
        self.dots.config(text="Mistakes remaining: " + "●" * self.mistakes)

    def toggle(self, word):
        if self.locked:
            return
        if word in self.selected:
            self.selected.remove(word)
        elif len(self.selected) < 4:
            self.selected.append(word)
        else:
            self.flash_msg("Select exactly four words.")
            return
        self.render()

    def flash_msg(self, text):
        self.msg.config(text=text)

    def shuffle(self):
        if self.locked:
            return
        random.shuffle(self.words)
        self.render()

    def deselect(self):
        if self.locked:
            return
        self.selected.clear()
        self.render()

    def submit(self):
        if self.locked or len(self.selected) != 4:
            self.flash_msg("Select exactly four words.")
            return
        guess = frozenset(self.selected)
        if guess in self.group_map:
            cat, lvl = self.group_map[guess]
            self.add_banner(cat, lvl, sorted(self.selected))
            self.words = [w for w in self.words if w not in guess]
            self.selected.clear()
            self.flash_msg("Correct!")
            self.render()
            if not self.words:
                self.win()
        else:
            best = max(len(guess & g) for g in self.group_map if not self.is_solved(g))
            self.mistakes -= 1
            self.update_dots()
            self.flash_msg("One away..." if best == 3 else "Not quite.")
            self.locked = True
            for w in self.selected:
                self.cells[w].config(bg="#b03a2e", fg="white")
            self.after(700, lambda: self.wrong_done())

    def is_solved(self, g):
        return not (g & set(self.words))
```

```python
    def __init__(self, groups):
        self.groups = groups
        self.word_group = {}
        for gi, (_, words, _) in enumerate(groups):
            for w in words:
                self.word_group[w] = gi
        self.remaining = [w for _, ws, _ in groups for w in ws]
        self.found = []
        self.mistakes = 0
        self.selected = []
        self.over = False
        self.won = False
        self.shuffle()

    def shuffle(self):
        random.shuffle(self.remaining)

    def toggle(self, word):
        if self.over or word not in self.remaining:
            return False
        if word in self.selected:
            self.selected.remove(word)
            return True
        if len(self.selected) < 4:
            self.selected.append(word)
            return True
        return False

    def clear_selection(self):
        self.selected = []

    def submit(self):
        if self.over or len(self.selected) != 4:
            return None
        gis = [self.word_group[w] for w in self.selected]
        distinct = set(gis)
        guess = list(self.selected)
        self.selected = []
        if len(distinct) == 1:
            gi = distinct.pop()
            self.found.append(gi)
            self.remaining = [w for w in self.remaining if self.word_group[w] != gi]
            if len(self.found) == len(self.groups):
                self.over = True
                self.won = True
            return {"correct": True, "group": gi, "guess": guess}
        matches = max(sum(1 for g in gis if g == gi) for gi in distinct)

            # reveal remaining

        return {"correct": False, "matches": matches, "guess": guess, "mistakes": self.mistakes}
```
